text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is coming up soon. As the tension builds, we celebrate the holiday season…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Happy Holidays, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, did I surprise you? I did all this while you were out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I didn't just decorate your room, either! There's also a carrot cake!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanted to thank you for everything you do for me. So, once again—Happy Holidays, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm glad that brought a smile to your face.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It feels like you've been really tense lately…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You helped me out so much.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why I really wanted to do something for you now.
choice_data_list: Thank you for doing this for me.
Thank you for doing this for me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You don't need to thank me! This is just as much for me as it is for you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I know we probably don't have the time to take our foot off the gas with such a big race ahead of us…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I wanna cherish this special time with you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We've got a race coming up, and it's one I can't lose. I wanna bring everything I've got to the race so I can win!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanna spend the day with you and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eek! T-trainer?
choice_data_list: Bring the feelings you have now to the race with you too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, I will!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! Let's dig into this cake! I'll slice it up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it looks super tasty! ♪
choice_data_list: Don't you go eating too much of it!
Don't you go eating too much of it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aww… I really wanna, but I understand. Not with my big race being so soon!
We enjoy a memorable evening together. It's a nice change of pace before heading into the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's kinda strange…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've… I've never spent the holidays like this before.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: With the Arima Kinen right around the corner, I'm really on edge…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But… this is fun. I'm having a really good time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Today, I just wanna be the Umamusume who has the most holiday fun in all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So let's do a whole lotta celebrating together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: First, we can have some cake. And then… Oh, I've got Santa hats that we can wear!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We'll eat chicken, and then, and then… Gah, there's so much I wanna do!
choice_data_list: Let's do everything you can think of!
Let's do everything you can think of!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I like the sound of that!
We enjoy a memorable evening together. It's a nice change of pace before heading into the Arima Kinen.
